module_summary: Synchronous circular-buffer FIFO: register-array memory indexed by wrapping read/write pointers, an occupancy counter producing full/empty/usage, optional fall-through bypass and clock-gated memory writes.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: FIFO storage array written at write pointer, read at read pointer

anchors.name: write_pointer_q
anchors.why: Write pointer, wraps at depth, addresses memory on push

anchors.name: read_pointer_q
anchors.why: Read pointer, wraps at depth, selects output data

anchors.name: status_cnt_q
anchors.why: Occupancy counter driving full, empty and usage

anchors.name: push_i
anchors.why: Push request writing data when not full

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Head-of-queue output data or fall-through input

anchors.name: pop_i
anchors.why: Pop request advancing read pointer when not empty

anchors.name: usage_o
anchors.why: Fill level output from occupancy counter

anchors.name: gate_clock
anchors.why: Memory write enable (clock gate) active only on push

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush command clearing pointers and counter

groups.name: FIFO storage
groups.description: Register array storing queue entries with gated writes

groups.name: Pointer and occupancy control
groups.description: Wrapping read/write pointers and counter generating full/empty/usage
